decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out below:MOA/OR/211108/ 02, MOA/OR/211108/ 04, MOA/OR/211108/ 04.1, MOA/OR/211108/ 05, MOA/OR/211108/ 05.1, MOA/OR/211108/ 10, DESIGN AND ACCESS STATEMENT   Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Prior to commencement of the development, a Tree Protection Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The plan should show the location of the tree with its RPA, and the location and specification of tree protective fencing around it. The fencing shall be installed prior to the commencement of development and retained in place until completion.Reason: Required prior to commencement of development to satisfy the Local Planning Authority that the tree to be retained will not be damaged during demolition or construction and to protect and enhance the appearance and character of the site and locality, in accordance with Policy DMD 80 of the Development Management Document (2014).

The glazing serving on drawing No MOA/OR/211108/ 04 and MOA/OR/211108/ 04.1 of the development indicated; shall be fixed shut and in obscured glass with an equivalent obscuration as level 3 on the Pilkington Obscuration Range. The glazing shall not be altered without the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining and neighbouring properties.
description: Creation of an additional floor to bungalow, single storey rear extension together with rear dormer and front and side rooflights.
